description_short: Executes confirmed jobs for the CoI Companion website. A job file exists only because it was confirmed on the website; this mod validates it (untampered, unexpired, pinned to the running game, capped) and schedules it as ONE shipped command — a blueprint placement (buildings, belts and pipes as ordinary construction sites) or, since 0.2.0, a terrain designation plan (mining / dumping / levelling cells added or removed in one batch). Ships disabled; nothing runs until enabled in the mod settings. Requires QoSCore.
